answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the orchard of free entry disappears, the whisper of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the grove case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
